title: Tiger Rag and the Jack Carey name
summary: He says the tune called 'Jack Carey' was really Tiger Rag, which the leader would call out during the number.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: now I want to tell you about Tiger Ragg and Jack Kerr I remember that was before I started playing the music playing before I started playing the music playing the band used to pass there on the corner on the way we was living on ramparts but of course the majority of the time together as Undertaker they called it Jack Kerrer but it was nothing but Tiger Ragg and Jack Kerrer from what I was told and when I got up and playing there used to play that thing and he used to make that and he used to holler Jack Kerrer and it was nothing but Tiger Ragg so he just went on and let it go like that like that and some people start calling it Tiger A. That's the real gospel truth. Some of them, some of them I meet today, they say man play Jack Carey, all you gotta do is play it and say Jack Carey, Jack Carey, that's that same time on the part where they make when they playing Tiger A. Jack Carey had what? Well they had a word for the two of them.
